body: Confirmed preliminary SIGPIPE finding with strace: after actual adopter reaps G, qualify_adopter cleanup write(hold_w, 1) returns EPIPE, immediately followed by SIGPIPE and caller death. Same failure reproduced using a fully static exact-module binary; static public prepare/cancel positive works with ignored SIGPIPE. Please have doer finalize the required abc8 READY report with honest full-gate outcomes/limits even if a gate failed; do not silently replace reviewed head while this review is active. Source-guard removal experiment in my scratch makes the non-reaper wrongly qualify, and exact source has been restored for rerun. Final review remains pending report, not approval.
